contest.measure_text: City Council Reform Measure Shall the voters amend the South El Monte Municipal Code to return to five elected City Council members and a Mayor selected from among the five elected City Council members? Supporters: Hector Delgado, Councilmember, City of South El Monte; Larry Rodriguez, Councilmember, City of South El Monte; Opponents: Gloria Olmos, Mayor of South El Monte; Manny Acosta, Councilmember of South El Monte
contest.office: CITY OF SOUTH EL MONTE SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION - MEASURE RM
